_note: Necessary conditions for an agent product requirements (design documents for an agent). Code checks each one on agent_prd.md after every build; the agent PRD is workable only when all are met, except a "severity": "warn" one (a heuristic check: Audit weighs it, it never blocks) and Audit accepts. "check" names the code check in j2.condition_met().

conditions.text: All sixteen sections are present and not empty
Requirement ids are unique and sequential (R1, R2, ...)
Action ids are unique and sequential (A1, A2, ...)
Must-never-do ids are unique and sequential (N1, N2, ...)
Every goal has a matching success metric
No invented facts: every number, email and proper name comes from the charter or the Requester's answers, or sits in an Assumption: line
Each numeric success metric states its measurement window, or says "measurement window not set"
